title: aidd stack
description: One stack in aidd's library (`stacks/<name>.yaml`): opinionated standards that go together, plus the `project.stack` entries they bring. A stack holds no rule text of its own. `aidd standard add --stack` copies its standards into a project.

name.description: The stack's name, the file's stem, such as `python-cli`.

description.description: What the stack is for, in one sentence.

extends.description: One other stack this one builds on, one level deep: a stack that extends a stack that extends another is refused, and so is a cycle.

standards.description: Ids of active opinionated standards in the library, at most one per open choice and ecosystem.

project.description: Entries `aidd standard add --stack` merges into the project's config.

stack.description: Technologies for the project's radar, as in `project.stack`.

checked.description: The day an agent last checked that the stack is still a set of standards that go together.

checked_by.description: Who checked the stack on `checked`: `agent:<harness>/<model>` for the agent that did, or a person's identity (`@login` or `email:<address>`).

items.description: Technologies by name, such as `uv` or `pytest`.
